title: How a P-Trap Protects Indoor Air Quality
description: A sink P-trap serves as a critical hydraulic seal between indoor air and the sewer network. Designed with a dipped curve, the pipe holds a small volume of water after every use. This retained water forms a tight liquid barrier that blocks sewer gas, odors, and pests from ascending back through the drain rim. When fresh wastewater enters from the sink basin, gravity displaces the old standing water into the main drain line while leaving clean water behind to re-establish the protective seal, provided the drain is properly vented.

When fresh wastewater enters from the sink basin, gravity displaces the old standing water into the main drain line while leaving clean water behind to re-establish the protective seal, provided the drain is properly vented.
